inventory.evidence_locator: Ausgrid 2025 DTAPR Substation Capacity and Demand Forecast workbook, Tech Spec (ZS) and Tech Spec (STS) sheets; independent openpyxl inventory by asset type + name + voltage.
inventory.notes: Independent inventory is assurance/inventories/ausgrid_substation_capacity_2025_ids.json. Scope includes every published zone substation and subtransmission substation in this workbook.

checks.method: Compare independent Tech Spec ZS/STS inventory against stdlib extraction and require every technical-spec asset to join to both Actual Demand and Demand Forecast sheets.
checks.result: 210 expected and 210 extracted; zero missing, extra or duplicate source records; zero actual-demand or forecast join gaps.

checks.method: Spot-check total capacity, firm capacity, load-transfer capacity and actual/forecast demand against published workbook rows; derived margins use arithmetic firm capacity minus reported demand only.
checks.evidence_locator: Ausgrid 2025 workbook Tech Spec, Actual Demand and Demand Forecast sheets plus derived CSV capacity_interpretation field.
checks.result: Published capacity/demand fields are retained separately. Derived apparent margins are explicitly labelled not guaranteed connection headroom. Full field-by-field verification remains outstanding.

notes: 177 zone substations and 33 subtransmission substations. Site coordinates/geometry and system-limitations joins are separate follow-on evidence; negative apparent firm margin is a constraint signal, not proof a new connection is impossible.
